81dd213566.q: How should you approach a difficult conversation to build connection and get better results?
81dd213566.a: Before expressing frustration or impatience, create a bridge to the other person's heart by acknowledging their circumstances first. Lead with gratitude and understanding, such as saying 'I know you're so busy, I know you have so much going on,' before bringing up your main concern. This approach keeps everyone even-keeled and makes people more open and willing to work with you, rather than becoming defensive or snippy.
